# Declaration and overload conformance audit

Pinned source: [b33cf54f24edc5347567c95b1924c447669c1de8](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/tree/b33cf54f24edc5347567c95b1924c447669c1de8).

Every one of the **3995 pinned declarations** appears in the JSON companion and the tables below. No percentage is advertised: native pointers, C# operators, platform controls, overloaded methods, and scalar enum values have different significance.

| Status | Declarations |
| --- | ---: |
| implemented | 716 |
| partial | 1436 |
| not-applicable | 873 |
| missing | 970 |

## Interpretation

- One row per pinned lexical declaration, retaining overload signature, source file, and line.
- Implemented means the listed managed argument shape has a concrete adapter or audited direct implementation; it is not a claim of native binary or total pixel compatibility.
- Partial means a callable/type exists with a documented difference, an untested semantic branch, or no completed signature-level audit. Method-name presence never upgrades a row to implemented.
- Not-applicable is reserved for C# language constructs, process pointers, P/Invoke, or non-web UI integration. These are not counted as implemented features.
- Missing means no matching browser type/member or an explicit unsupported overload.
- This is a conservative extension audit. Separate font, document, resource, animation, region/effect, and GPU test reports provide additional evidence and may certify rows still marked partial here.
- JavaScript mappings: ref/out structs use mutable objects; spans use arrays/typed arrays; numeric values use JavaScript Number; overload dispatch is dynamic.
- Pinned-source corrections include System.Numerics row-vector SKMatrix44 storage, default Empty construction, midpoint-to-even checked Int32 rounding, exact value-zero SKRect.IsEmpty, degenerate rectangle intersection/union, and default warped text-on-path.
- The inventory is lexical, includes preprocessor branches and obsolete forms, and does not expand inherited members. It is not compiler-produced metadata.

## Known exactness limits

- The underlying CanvasKit ABI does not expose native `setMatrix`; singular transform recovery requires a saved canvas state.
- Rounded-rectangle arbitrary start-index paths now cover all eight indices and both directions. Anisotropic sampling, several specialized/native pixel overloads, and native platform pointer integrations still need distinct backend support.
- `BreakText` without an output object keeps the original JavaScript result object. Its `valueOf()` returns the count; the explicit output form returns a count and populates the width/text object.
- Warped glyph outlines use adaptive flattening with a 0.2 px target. Exact native contour ordering and native glyph-warp tolerance are not claimed.
- `GetFillPath` performs real path stroking and optional effect baking. Native fast-bounds internals and all effect combinations are not directly exposed.
- Full .NET source-level API parity is not complete. This report intentionally leaves unverified branches partial or missing.
